research.note: Reading: AFCON excitement and cynicism in Kenyan posts, the last month.

calls.purpose: AFCON posts with excited wording, creators and platforms
calls.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS posts, COUNT(DISTINCT p.creator_id) AS authors, COUNT(DISTINCT p.platform) AS platforms FROM intelligence_42_core.posts p WHERE CONTAINS_SUBSTR(p.text, @term) AND @stance = 'excited'

calls.purpose: AFCON posts with cynical wording, creators and platforms
calls.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS posts, COUNT(DISTINCT p.creator_id) AS authors, COUNT(DISTINCT p.platform) AS platforms FROM intelligence_42_core.posts p WHERE CONTAINS_SUBSTR(p.text, @term) AND @stance = 'cynical'

writer.short_answer: Excitement is ahead of cynicism in Kenyan posts, but the cynical posts are about stadiums and ticket prices and are not going away.

claims.text: Of the posts that took a side, 118 sounded excited and 91 sounded cynical, classified by the wording they use.
